questions.question_english: Identify the incorrect statement regarding the eligibility of dependent parents for family pension:

questions.explanation_english: Dependent parents do not share family pension equally with a surviving spouse. questions.question_english: If a pensioner under OPS takes up commercial employment within one year of retirement, what is the mandatory requirement?
options_english: They must surrender 50% of their pension.
They must return the Retirement Gratuity.
They are disqualified from drawing any pension for the duration of the employment.

questions.explanation_english: Group A officers must obtain prior permission from the Government. Under the Central Civil Services (Pension) Rules, a retired Group A officer who wishes to accept commercial employment within one year of retirement must obtain prior written permission from the Central Government. Accepting commercial employment without required sanction may lead to withholding or forfeiture of pensionary benefits.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। ग्रुप ए के अधिकारियों को सरकार से पूर्व अनुमति प्राप्त करनी होगी। केंद्रीय सिविल सेवाओं (पेंशन) नियमों के तहत, एक सेवानिवृत्त ग्रुप ए अधिकारी जिसे सेवानिवृत्ति के एक वर्ष के भीतर व्यावसायिक रोजगार स्वीकार करना है, उसे केंद्रीय सरकार से पूर्व लिखित अनुमति प्राप्त करनी होगी। बिना आवश्यक स्वीकृति के व्यावसायिक रोजगार स्वीकार करने से पेंशन लाभों के रोकने या जब्ती का कारण बन सकता है।
key_facts: Central Civil Services (Pension) Rules mandate prior permission for Group A officers.
Accepting employment without permission can lead to forfeiture of pension.
Printed answer key: (D) Group A officers must obtain prior permission from the Government.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the processing of a pension case by the Head of Office (HoO):
I. The HoO must issue a certificate regarding the verification of service length to the employee 5 years before retirement.
II. Forms for claiming pension must be handed over to the retiring official strictly one month before retirement.
III. The HoO sends the pension papers to the Pay and Accounts Officer (PAO) not later than six months before the date of retirement.
IV. The PAO issues the Pension Payment Order (PPO) and forwards it to the Central Pension Accounting Office (CPAO).

I, III, and IV
II, III, and IV

questions.explanation_english: The Head of Office must issue a service verification certificate five years before retirement, send pension papers to the PAO eight months prior to superannuation, and the PAO issues the PPO. However, pension application forms are handed over to the employee fifteen months before retirement, making the one-month timeline incorrect.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। कार्यालय प्रमुख को सेवानिवृत्ति से 5 वर्ष पहले सेवा सत्यापन प्रमाण पत्र जारी करना चाहिए, पेंशन पत्रों को PAO को सेवानिवृत्ति से आठ महीने पहले भेजना चाहिए, और PAO PPO जारी करता है। हालाँकि, पेंशन आवेदन फॉर्म कर्मचारी को सेवानिवृत्ति से पंद्रह महीने पहले सौंपे जाते हैं, जिससे एक महीने की समय सीमा गलत हो जाती है।
key_facts: HoO must issue service verification certificate 5 years before retirement.

PAO issues the Pension Payment Order (PPO).

questions.question_english: Which of the following best defines the concept of “positive rights” in the human rights framework?
options_english: Rights that explicitly restrain the State from infringing upon basic individual liberties.
Rights that are formally codified within the written constitutional provisions of a nation.
Rights requiring the State to actively provide basic social services and opportunities.
Rights that apply universally to all global citizens without requiring State intervention.
questions.explanation_english: The correct option is C, as positive rights are those that require the state to take action to ensure that individuals have access to certain basic services and opportunities. This contrasts with negative rights, which require the state to refrain from interfering in individual liberties. Understanding this distinction is crucial in the context of human rights discussions, particularly in evaluating the role of the state in providing social welfare.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। सकारात्मक अधिकार वे हैं जो राज्य से यह मांग करते हैं कि वह व्यक्तियों को कुछ बुनियादी सेवाओं और अवसरों तक पहुँच प्रदान करने के लिए सक्रिय रूप से कार्य करे। यह नकारात्मक अधिकारों के विपरीत है, जो राज्य से यह अपेक्षा करते हैं कि वह व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रताओं में हस्तक्षेप न करे। मानवाधिकार चर्चाओं में इस भेद को समझना महत्वपूर्ण है, विशेष रूप से सामाजिक कल्याण प्रदान करने में राज्य की भूमिका का मूल्यांकन करते समय।
key_facts: Positive rights require state action for service provision.
Negative rights focus on non-interference by the state.
Printed answer key: (C) Rights requiring the State to actively provide basic social services and opportunities.

questions.question_english: A newly recruited teacher joins a school and submits a nomination for GPF and Gratuity. Six months later, one of the three nominees (allocated 30% share) passes away. According to the rules, what is the consequence?
options_english: The entire nomination form becomes completely invalid immediately, requiring a mandatory fresh submission through the DDO.
The deceased nominee’s 30% share automatically reverts to the government treasury upon the official recording of death.
A revised nomination must be filed; otherwise, the share is divided among surviving family members.
The deceased nominee’s share is automatically distributed equally among all remaining surviving nominees listed in the form.
questions.explanation_english: When a nominated family member passes away during the government servant’s service, the share allocated to that deceased nominee does not automatically transfer to other nominees. questions.explanation_english: The General Provident Fund (Central Services) Rules, 1960 apply fundamentally to government servants appointed on or before December 31, 2003, who are covered under the Old Pension Scheme. questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। सामान्य भविष्य निधि (केंद्रीय सेवाएँ) नियम, 1960 उन सरकारी सेवकों पर लागू होते हैं जो 31 दिसंबर, 2003 से पहले नियुक्त हुए हैं और पुराने पेंशन योजना के अंतर्गत आते हैं। 1 जनवरी, 2004 के बाद नियुक्त कर्मचारी राष्ट्रीय पेंशन प्रणाली के अधीन होते हैं और GPF में योगदान करने के लिए अयोग्य होते हैं। यह भेद सरकारी कर्मचारियों के विभिन्न समूहों के लिए पेंशन योजनाओं की प्रासंगिकता को समझने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है।

options_english: Up to 60% lump sum withdrawal, and at least 40% for annuity purchase.
Up to 40% can be withdrawn as a lump sum, while at least 60% must be utilized for mandatory annuity purchase.
60% for annuity, and 40% as lump sum.
40% as lump sum, and 60% for annuity.
questions.explanation_english: Upon normal superannuation at age sixty, an NPS subscriber can withdraw up to sixty percent of their accumulated pension corpus as a tax-free lump sum. questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। सामान्य सुपरएन्यूएशन पर, NPS सदस्य अपने संचित पेंशन कोष का 60% एकमुश्त के रूप में निकाल सकते हैं। शेष न्यूनतम 40% पेंशन कोष को अनिवार्य रूप से वार्षिकी खरीदने के लिए उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए, ताकि जीवन के लिए नियमित मासिक पेंशन भुगतान प्रदान किया जा सके।
key_facts: NPS allows up to 60% lump sum withdrawal at superannuation.

Understanding the historical context of this declaration is crucial for comprehending its impact on global human rights standards.

6 months after filing FIR and police non-traceable report.
After a mandatory waiting period of exactly two years from missing date.

questions.explanation_english: When a government servant disappears and their whereabouts remain unknown, the family can be granted family pension and gratuity six months after filing a Police First Information Report, provided the police issue a non-traceable report and the family executes an indemnity bond with required sureties.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। जब एक सरकारी कर्मचारी लापता हो जाता है और उनके ठिकाने का पता नहीं चलता है, तो परिवार को परिवार पेंशन और ग्रेच्युटी छह महीने बाद दी जा सकती है जब पुलिस पहली सूचना रिपोर्ट दर्ज कर देती है, बशर्ते पुलिस एक गैर-ट्रेस रिपोर्ट जारी करे और परिवार आवश्यक जमानत के साथ एक प्रतिपूर्ति बांड निष्पादित करे।
key_facts: Family pension can be granted after 6 months of filing FIR.

Joint life annuity with 100% pension to spouse and return of purchase price to nominee.
Guaranteed annuity payable for a fixed period of 15 years certain and thereafter for the remaining lifetime of subscriber.
Inflation-indexed single life annuity increasing automatically by a fixed rate of 5% annually throughout life.
questions.explanation_english: For government sector subscribers exiting the National Pension System upon retirement, the default annuity variant prescribed by rules is a joint life annuity. questions.question_english: Which of the following rights is classified under the economic, social, and cultural rights enumerated in the latter half of the UDHR (Articles 22-27)?
options_english: The right to equal pay for equal work
The right to a fair and public hearing
The right to freedom of peaceful assembly
The right to seek asylum
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is the right to equal pay for equal work, which is recognized as an economic and social right. This right ensures that individuals receive fair compensation for their labor, promoting equality and social justice. It is essential for fostering a fair work environment and is aligned with the principles outlined in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। समान कार्य के लिए समान वेतन का अधिकार एक आर्थिक और सामाजिक अधिकार के रूप में मान्यता प्राप्त है। यह अधिकार सुनिश्चित करता है कि व्यक्तियों को उनके श्रम के लिए उचित मुआवजा मिले, जो समानता और सामाजिक न्याय को बढ़ावा देता है। यह एक निष्पक्ष कार्य वातावरण को बढ़ावा देने के लिए आवश्यक है और मानवाधिकारों की सार्वभौमिक घोषणा में वर्णित सिद्धांतों के अनुरूप है।
key_facts: Economic, social, and cultural rights are essential for human dignity.
Printed answer key: (A) The right to equal pay for equal work

questions.question_english: A school Principal is processing the retirement of a PGT who has an ongoing vigilance inquiry. As per the rules, what must the Principal do regarding the payment of Gratuity?
options_english: Disburse the full gratuity amount immediately on superannuation date to avoid paying penal interest.
Disburse 50% of the gratuity amount immediately and withhold the remaining balance pending inquiry.
Convert the entire accumulated gratuity amount into a temporary non-withdrawable NPS Tier II account.
Withhold entire gratuity until final orders in departmental or judicial proceedings.
questions.explanation_english: When departmental or judicial proceedings are pending against a retiring government servant, the Head of Office must withhold the payment of Retirement Gratuity until the final orders are passed by the competent authority. No provisional gratuity is disbursed during the pendency of vigilance inquiries or formal disciplinary cases.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। जब सेवानिवृत्त सरकारी कर्मचारी के खिलाफ विभागीय या न्यायिक कार्यवाही लंबित होती है, तब कार्यालय का प्रमुख सेवानिवृत्ति ग्रेच्युटी के भुगतान को रोकना चाहिए जब तक कि सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा अंतिम आदेश पारित नहीं किए जाते। सतर्कता जांच या औपचारिक अनुशासनात्मक मामलों के दौरान कोई अस्थायी ग्रेच्युटी वितरित नहीं की जाती है।
key_facts: Gratuity payment is withheld during pending inquiries.
Final orders by competent authority are necessary for disbursement.
No provisional gratuity during vigilance inquiries.
Printed answer key: (D) Withhold entire gratuity until final orders in departmental or judicial proceedings.

questions.question_english:
Identify the incorrect statement regarding the
responsibilities of the Head of Office (HoO)
under the CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021:
options_english: The HoO must initiate the pension case strictly one year before the date of superannuation.
The HoO must verify the qualifying service after the government servant completes 18 years of service or is left with five years of service before retirement.
The HoO has the authority to sanction a provisional pension if the final pension is delayed for administrative reasons not linked to departmental proceedings.
The HoO can unilaterally withhold up to 50% of the pension if the retiring employee fails to vacate government accommodation.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is option (d) because the Head of Office does not have the unilateral authority to withhold up to fifty percent of an employee’s pension for failure to vacate official accommodation. Withholding or recovery of pensionary benefits requires strict adherence to statutory authorization procedures. Such actions must follow prescribed statutory rules, and unilateral decisions in this regard are impermissible under central pension regulations.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। कार्यालय के प्रमुख के पास सरकारी आवास को खाली करने में असफल रहने पर कर्मचारी की पेंशन का 50% एकतरफा रूप से रोकने का अधिकार नहीं है। पेंशन लाभों को रोकने या वसूली करने के लिए कानूनी प्राधिकरण प्रक्रियाओं का सख्त पालन आवश्यक है। इस संबंध में एकतरफा निर्णय केंद्रीय पेंशन नियमों के तहत अस्वीकार्य हैं।
key_facts: HoO को पेंशन मामले की शुरुआत सेवानिवृत्ति की तारीख से एक साल पहले करनी चाहिए।
Printed answer key: (D) The HoO can unilaterally withhold up to 50% of the pension if the retiring employee fails to vacate government accommodation.
